confirmation_jun_jul2026.notes: Recorder/live-parity era. Never train/tune on these sessions.

extension_2023.notes: Placeholder for a possible 2023 extension tier. No sessions should use this until approved and accepted.

extension_2024h1.notes: Placeholder for a possible 2024-01 through 2024-09 purchase tier. No sessions should use this until approved and accepted.

owned_jul_dec2025.notes: Mechanically valid for new fold-trained candidates; interpret family-level claims with historical program-ancestry caveat.

post_q1_gap_apr_may2026.notes: Post-Q1 gap stays out of fold selection unless separately governed.

pre_program_oct2024_jun2025.notes: Cleanest owned pre-program era after raw acceptance gates pass.

q1_2026_development.notes: Default report-only. Jan-Feb may be upgraded only after explicit design/threshold ancestry audit.

unassigned_requires_decision.notes: Fail-closed. No fold scaffold may place this era.

pre_program_systematic_negative_guard.if: pooled criteria pass but pre_program_oct2024_jun2025 test folds are systematically negative
pre_program_systematic_negative_guard.reason: Pooled fold success must not hide failure in the cleanest owned pre-program era.

role_taxonomy.confirmation_one_shot: May be used only for one-shot live/parity confirmation, not training or tuning.
role_taxonomy.diagnostics_only: May appear in diagnostics-tier fold test windows for gates, samplers, nulls, and uplift; never model-tier train/test.
role_taxonomy.report_only: May be summarized for context but not used for model selection, diagnostics gates, or promotion claims.
role_taxonomy.test: May appear in model-tier test windows when all acceptance and fold predicates pass.
role_taxonomy.train: May appear in model-tier training windows when all acceptance and fold predicates pass.
